answer: A payout is split thus 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The anchor schedule is applied in zenith and river reveals each instalment. Someone as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1572 identities would post 2889 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
